---
title: "Dengue serotype dynamics paper accepted at Lancet ID"
date: 2026-04-14
categories: [Preprint]
description: "The network's flagship multi-country study lands after two years of data harmonisation."
---

The network's flagship multi-country study on dengue serotype dynamics has been accepted for publication in The Lancet Infectious Diseases. This paper represents two years of collaborative data harmonisation across six MIDSEA member countries.
